authResetDescription: We’ll send a reset link to your email.

setupSubtitle: Live mode is enabled, but tenant config is incomplete.

authBackendNotReadyTitle: Backend auth is not ready yet

readinessSubtitle: Track industrial go-live blockers and next checks.
readinessBackendFlagsHint: Patient login and registration must be enabled on the tenant before live onboarding.
readinessEnvReady: Environment ready for live login checks
readinessEnvBlocked: Environment blocked for live login checks
readinessNext1: Enable patient login + registration on tenant settings.
readinessNext2: Run patient A/B data-isolation verification on live backend.
readinessNext3: Execute real-device reminder reliability test matrix.
readinessChecklistHint: Tap an item to mark it done after you validate it on real devices/backend.
readinessTaskAuthSmokeTitle: Live patient sign-in + registration smoke test
readinessTaskAuthSmokeSubtitle: Complete one sign-in and one registration on live backend.
readinessTaskIsolationSubtitle: Confirm one patient cannot read or edit another patient’s records.
readinessTaskReminderIosTitle: iOS reminder test with app closed
readinessTaskReminderIosSubtitle: Run overnight reminder check with the app fully closed.
readinessTaskReminderAndroidTitle: Android reminder test with app closed
readinessTaskReminderAndroidSubtitle: Run overnight reminder check with the app fully closed.
readinessTaskTimezoneSubtitle: Verify reminders stay on local wall-clock time after timezone/DST changes.
readinessTaskReportSubtitle: Validate readability and usefulness of the exported report.
readinessTaskConsentSubtitle: Verify consent create + withdraw events are traceable.
readinessTaskA11ySubtitle: Check dynamic text, focus order, and non-color-only status cues.
readinessRoadmapPhase1: Phase 1 · Backend auth and tenant readiness
readinessRoadmapPhase6: Phase 6 · Observability, QA, and release operations
readinessAuthNeedsSignIn: Auth endpoint is reachable. Sign in to verify patient data access and flows.
readinessAuthOffline: Tenant auth endpoint could not be reached. Check tenant code and backend route availability.
readinessFlagsBlocked: Tenant is reachable, but patient login and registration are still disabled or unavailable.
isolationSubtitle: Run and record cross-patient access checks before go-live.
isolationVerdictPass: All six cases passed with tester and date recorded.
isolationVerdictPending: Complete all six cases and capture tester/date.
isolationCaseAReadsASubtitle: Sign in as A and confirm only A data appears in Today, Medications, and History.
isolationCaseAReadsBDeniedSubtitle: As A, attempt to fetch B resources and confirm denied/empty response.
isolationCaseAWritesBDeniedSubtitle: As A, attempt MedicationAdministration write with subject Patient/B and confirm rejection.
isolationCaseBReadsBSubtitle: Sign in as B and confirm only B data appears in Today, Medications, and History.
isolationCaseBReadsADeniedSubtitle: As B, attempt to fetch A resources and confirm denied/empty response.
isolationCaseBWritesADeniedSubtitle: As B, attempt MedicationAdministration write with subject Patient/A and confirm rejection.
isolationNotesPlaceholder: Case IDs, status codes, and screenshot links
isolationEvidenceHint: Store screenshots and request/response traces in your release folder, then paste references here.
reminderCertSubtitle: Run real-device reminder tests and record release evidence.
reminderCertReadinessSyncSubtitle: A1, A2, C1, and C2 update release blockers automatically.
reminderCaseA1Title: A1 · iOS overnight with app closed
reminderCaseA1Subtitle: Force-close app, lock phone overnight, verify reminder and dose logging path.
reminderCaseA2Title: A2 · Android overnight with app closed
reminderCaseA2Subtitle: Force-close app, lock phone overnight, verify reminder delivery and logging path.
reminderCaseB1Subtitle: Reboot before next dose and verify reminder still fires with app closed.
reminderCaseB2Subtitle: Reboot before next dose and verify reminder survives reboot and battery mode.
reminderCaseC1Subtitle: Change timezone and confirm next reminder stays on intended local time.
reminderCaseC2Subtitle: Verify no skipped or duplicate reminder around DST transition.
reminderCaseD1Subtitle: Confirm old reminder cancels and updated time schedules correctly.
reminderCaseD2Subtitle: Pause regimen and confirm future reminders stop.
reminderCaseD3Subtitle: Archive regimen and confirm no future reminders fire.
reminderCaseE1Subtitle: Snooze a reminder and confirm one follow-up arrives at configured delay.
reminderCertNotesPlaceholder: Case IDs, observed timing deltas, screenshot/video links
reminderCertEvidenceHint: Link each case to screenshots and request/response traces in your release folder.
reminderCertNoCriticalBlockers: No critical reminder blockers for A1, A2, C1, and C2.
reminderCertCriticalBlockers: Critical reminder blockers remain. Complete A1, A2, C1, and C2.
sessionQaSubtitle: Run security and auth lifecycle checks before release.
sessionQaP0Hint: All P0 cases must pass on iOS and Android.
sessionQaCase01Subtitle: Valid credentials create a session and unlock protected routes.
sessionQaCase02Subtitle: Invalid password shows a clear error and keeps protected routes blocked.
sessionQaCase03Subtitle: New patient registration completes without orphaned state.
sessionQaCase04Subtitle: Existing email returns a clear duplicate-account error.
sessionQaCase05Subtitle: Sign-out clears token and routes back to authentication gate.
sessionQaCase06Subtitle: After restart, valid session restores without forced login.
sessionQaCase07Subtitle: After sign-out and restart, app remains signed out.
sessionQaCase08Subtitle: Invalid/expired token redirects to sign-in with actionable message.
sessionQaCase09Subtitle: Unauthenticated access to protected routes stays blocked.
sessionQaCase10Subtitle: Switching from A to B shows no stale A data.
sessionQaCase11Subtitle: Consent appears only when required and remains traceable.
sessionQaCase12Subtitle: When auth backend is unavailable, app shows guidance without crash.
sessionQaCase13Subtitle: Invalid mutation payload returns controlled error with no silent failure.
sessionQaCase14Subtitle: Operator-facing errors are plain, specific, and actionable.
sessionQaNotesPlaceholder: Case IDs, status codes, screenshots, log snippets, ticket references
sessionQaEvidenceHint: Capture each failed case with repro steps, log evidence, and a mitigation note.
sessionQaGatePass: P0 security gate passed with evidence metadata captured.
sessionQaGateBlocked: Security gate blocked. Resolve open P0 cases and capture evidence metadata.
readinessTaskSessionQaSubtitle: Pass all P0 auth/session cases and malformed payload checks.
reportReviewSubtitle: Capture clinical sign-off for the one-page adherence report.
reportReviewGatePass: Checklist complete with acceptable verdict and reviewer metadata.
reportReviewGateBlocked: Complete checklist, reviewer metadata, and set verdict to PASS or PASS WITH MINOR EDITS.
reportReviewCheckIdentity: Patient identity is clear for clinical workflow.
reportReviewCheckWindow: Date and review window context is clear.
reportReviewCheckAdherence: Overall adherence percentage is easy to interpret.
reportReviewCheckPerMed: Per-medication rows are clear and actionable.
reportReviewCheckMissedRisk: Missed-dose section communicates risk behavior without overstatement.
reportReviewCheckNoRecommendation: Text does not imply diagnosis or treatment recommendation.
reportReviewCheckBoundary: Report boundary is clear: adherence evidence, not decision support.
reportReviewCheckReadability: Font size and spacing stay readable in PDF/print.
reportReviewCheckEn: English wording is natural and unambiguous.
reportReviewCheckDe: German wording is natural and unambiguous.
reportReviewCheckDrift: No clinically meaningful translation drift between EN and DE.
reportReviewRequiredChangesPlaceholder: List wording that must change before release.
reportReviewPriorityBeforeReleasePlaceho: List must-fix items with owner and due date.
reportReviewHint: Capture concrete examples from reviewed PDFs so copy edits stay traceable.
consentAuditSubtitle: Verify grant and withdraw events are traceable before release.
consentAuditTraceabilityPass: Both grant and withdraw consent events are present in FHIR Consent history.
consentAuditTraceabilityBlocked: Record at least one grant and one withdraw event to complete traceability evidence.
consentAuditCheckGrant: Consent grant event is created and visible in Consent history.
consentAuditCheckWithdraw: Consent withdraw event is created and visible in Consent history.
consentAuditCheckTimeline: Timeline order is correct (grant before withdraw) in captured evidence.
consentAuditCheckRoute: Withdrawing consent returns user to consent route and blocks medication screens.
consentAuditCheckEvidence: Screenshots/log traces are exported into release evidence folder.
consentAuditCheckLegalCopy: EN/DE consent copy was reviewed with legal/compliance owner.
consentAuditEvidenceLinksPlaceholder: Paste screenshot folder, ticket, and trace links.
consentAuditFindingsPlaceholder: Document issues, owner, and due date.
consentAuditLoadError: Couldn’t load consent history. Check patient/session and retry.
releaseHubSubtitle: Run every launch gate from one screen and open the right evidence board in one tap.
releaseHubNotReady: Release is blocked until all critical gates are passed.
releaseHubAuth: Live sign-in and registration smoke test
releaseHubAuthHint: Confirms patient auth is working on the connected tenant.
releaseHubTimezoneHint: Verify reminders stay correct after timezone changes and DST boundaries.
releaseHubA11yHint: Large text and screen reader pass must be documented before launch.
releaseHubNextReminder: Finish all pending critical checks in the list above.
releaseHubNextEvidence: Confirm evidence links are filled in consent, report, and session boards.
releaseHubNextSignoff: Run final dry-run sign-off with clinical and operations owners.
a11yPassSubtitle: Run large-text and screen-reader launch checks and store evidence in one place.
a11yEvidenceHint: Tester, date, device, and assistive technology are required for release sign-off.
a11yCaseLargeTextTodaySubtitle: At 200% text size, dose cards and action buttons stay readable and tappable.
a11yCaseLargeTextMedsSubtitle: Medication names, dosage details, and status chips do not truncate critical meaning.
a11yCaseLargeTextHistorySubtitle: Adherence summary and report preview remain understandable at max font scaling.
a11yCaseScreenReaderTabSubtitle: VoiceOver or TalkBack reads tab labels in a logical order with clear context.
a11yCaseScreenReaderDoseSubtitle: Taken, Skip, Snooze, and Undo actions announce intent and result clearly.
a11yCaseNonColorSubtitle: Dose status remains clear without relying on color alone.
a11yCaseFocusOrderSubtitle: Sign in, consent, add medication, and report export follow a predictable focus sequence.
a11yCaseRotationSubtitle: Portrait and landscape transitions do not hide actions or break structure.
a11yEvidenceFootnote: Capture links to screenshots or recordings in your release tracker.
